zh.title: NTSB尋獲Learjet 60墜機案駕駛艙語音記錄器
zh.summary: NTSB尋獲Learjet 60駕駛艙語音記錄器，正由華盛頓實驗室評估
body: NTSB表示，已尋獲一架Learjet 60的駕駛艙語音記錄器。該機於11月1日在佛羅裏達州Greenacres附近墜毀，機上9人全數罹難；該機由Aurora Aviation以Upper Jets名義營運。
記錄器目前在NTSB位於華盛頓特區的Vehicle Recorders Laboratory接受評估。NTSB指出，駕駛艙語音記錄器會記錄無線電傳輸及座艙聲音，包括飛行員語音與引擎聲。NTSB表示，天候狀況及空中解體相關證據均在調查中。

en.title: NTSB Recovers Learjet 60 Cockpit Voice Recorder After Fatal Florida Crash
en.summary: NTSB recovered the Learjet 60 cockpit voice recorder; it is being evaluated in Washington, D.C.
body: The NTSB says it has recovered the cockpit voice recorder from a Learjet 60. The aircraft crashed near Greenacres, Florida, on 1 November, killing all nine people on board. It was operated by Aurora Aviation, doing business as Upper Jets.

The CVR is currently being evaluated in the NTSB Vehicle Recorders Laboratory in Washington, D.C. The NTSB says cockpit voice recorders record radio transmissions and sounds in the cockpit, including pilot voices and engine noises. The NTSB said weather conditions and evidence of an in-flight breakup are both being investigated.
